sql_templates.description: Identify top-ranked VCP breakout stocks with strong fundamentals.
sql_templates.name: find_vcp_breakouts
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_vcp AS (
    SELECT symbol, company_name, sector, price, vcp_score, enhanced_fund_score
    FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
    ORDER BY vcp_score DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT lv.symbol, lv.company_name, lv.sector, lv.price, lv.vcp_score, sm.fundamental_score
FROM latest_vcp lv
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots sm ON lv.symbol = sm.symbol
WHERE sm.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND sm.enhanced_fund_score > 80;
